description: One closed example of each Cubist construct with a term to evaluate, for the evaluation demand marks note: its weak head on main 0b914137, and E324 where evaluation refuses an assumption. Run with probe.mjs constructs. K2.5 restated the four assumption examples, B95 to B98, over the library’s axioms and an axiom of their own, in place of the legacy builtins over Truncate (2026-10-26 and 2026-10-28); a definition is abstracted over its assumptions, so each has a lambda for its weak head.
